experts.summary: Carolina’s weak run defense could unlock Jacobs and Love’s play action. Carolina protection injuries strengthen Green Bay’s defensive case.

Green Bay interior-line absences and inefficient rushing support fewer points. Ward also backs Carolina with the hook, opposing Lanfranca’s side. The cited under threshold is 47.5; the portal total may differ.
Road/short-week conditions and Green Bay’s suppression of passing touchdowns support the under.
Carty’s workload projection is below the quoted rushing-attempt threshold. This is a source opinion, not a portal player model.
experts.direction: MarShawn Lloyd under 5.5 rushing attempts (-103), price limit -146

experts.summary: Coker’s target share and touchdown opportunity support the cited longshot. Scoring remains volatile.
Koerner favors a Carolina scoring rebound through Hubbard and play action against depleted linebackers. Packers protection and pace create possession upside; both offensive lines remain concerns.
experts.direction: Panthers team total over 20.5 (-125) or 21.5 (-105 to -115)

experts.summary: Hubbard’s yards after contact and zone running fit Green Bay’s linebacker absences. Koerner expects more rushing volume after last week’s low workload.
experts.direction: Chuba Hubbard over 65.5 rushing yards (-115 DraftKings)

experts.summary: Coker’s slot usage fits zone coverage. Carolina protection problems support interception risk; Golden’s injuries and downfield protection concerns support the receiving fade. These are Kalshi event thresholds, not sportsbook odds.
experts.direction: Coker 5+ receptions; Young 1+ interceptions; Golden 70+ receiving yards NO

experts.summary: Green Bay’s slot coverage challenges Coker; downfield volatility discourages a confident spread stance.
PFF ranks Carolina 26th and Green Bay 29th. Moton’s loss forces a rookie tackle; Green Bay’s right side struggled before Rhyan’s injury.
experts.direction: Both offensive lines carry material protection risks

experts.summary: Jacobs’s workload meets weak run defense; Hubbard owns red-zone usage. Love’s clean-pocket efficiency and Watson’s explosive catches support the receiving legs.
experts.direction: Jacobs 70+ rush/rec; Hubbard TD; Love 240+ pass; Watson 60+ receiving
